title: Authenticate European Firaga indirect index 2 record
changes: Authenticate an eight-byte index-2 physical record for a previously established indirect reader.
validation: Protected source plan e353-firaga-indirect-index2-source-plan-lojq8qbl checks exact EUR code, existing root, record ownership and seven sampled bytes.
limitations: The sample does not attribute executing PCs or pointer ancestry and does not establish guest bounds. Runtime publication, other indices/callers/scenes, Linux, USA and native Windows remain open. No performance comparison was made.
